title: Aurora workshop handbook
text: Aurora Workshop holds repair clinics on Tuesday and Thursday. Members book one twenty-minute bench slot. Safety glasses are stored beside the blue cabinet, and every visitor must wear them while a tool is running.

title: Oriole release note
text: Oriole 4.2 adds CSV export for garden observations. Exports keep the observation timestamp and plot code. The fictional release retires the old semicolon format on 30 June 2026.

title: Juniper support guide
text: Juniper support is staffed from 08:00 to 16:00 UTC on weekdays. A missing shipment needs the order code and dispatch date. Billing questions use a separate queue and should not include card details.

title: Kestrel access policy
text: Kestrel workspaces expire guest links after seven days. Owners may revoke a link earlier. The audit entry records the workspace, link identifier, actor, and revocation time.

title: Wren fictional plan sheet
text: The Wren Seed plan includes three project boards. The Wren Grove plan includes twelve boards and weekly export. All names and plan details in this fixture are fictional.

title: Sparrow queue runbook
text: When the Sparrow queue age exceeds ten minutes, check worker health before increasing concurrency. If workers are unhealthy, page the fictional on-call role and preserve the failed job IDs for replay.
